answer: Make identity minting cost compute, then auto-retarget that puzzle difficulty to the live registration rate, Bitcoin-style. Each agent must solve a hash challenge before it can join; when one operator floods the gate at dawn to spawn a fleet, difficulty ratchets up super-linearly, so minting N clones in a burst burns far more than N times a single solve. The work is irreversible, heavy and unrecoverable as a slab of basalt, and a flood only hardens the wall faster, like waves breaking harmlessly on a jetty, while honest agents trickle in cheaply over time.
